nom: Clinique Acne Solutions Clarifying Face Lotion

avis.titre: Great stuff, but not for sensitive skin
avis.texte: This toner is alcohol-based and almost smells like you could use it to strip paint, so I would avoid it if you have sensitive or particularly dry skin, but my face is basically an oil slick, and I find that it definitely makes a difference in helping to control my acne. I can see on the cotton pad that it's a great exfoliant. Despite the fact that my face can handle almost any product/treatment you could throw at it, I only use it 4-5 times a week.
This is alcohol based so it dries out your face and the smell is awful. I was getting more breakouts. Their regular clarifying lotion (toner) is much better. Disappointed in this clinique purchase.

avis.titre: I love this Clinique line of products
avis.texte: I am a senior citizen and still have occasional breakouts. However, I use several products from the Acne Solutions line and they work for me. If I do get a pimple, it is usually small and goes away quickly. I love this line and will continue to use it.
I love this so much. I have been using it for soo long and still does wonders for my skin. I highly recommend this!!!

okay so i've been offically using this 3 step acne line for almost a month now. The toner really burns me i don't know how else to incorporate it into my skin care routine. i usually wash my face in the shower with the foaming cleanser from this line, then i take a cotton ball and very lightly swipe scross my face with the exfoliater. It finally got so bad my forhead turned red and swollen and was VERY tight i started to cry a lot. yes i did start off with the toner every other day/week because it was 2 strong for me personally but i haven't been using it on my forhead at all anymore i am traumatized. I think it "works" but harshly very harsh. My acne is getting better but its like in exchange for no more acne i am getting so much texture all over my face that i did not have before. Various little white bumps are spreading all over my chin/mouth area i am honestly so defeated. I am gonna try to use the rest of these products because they were expensive to buy all together at full size. I recommend these ONLY if you are okay with purging a lot before it gets better :(

I absolutely love this product. I've been using it for over two years now and since I have started it have had almost NO acne. I ran out of it a few months ago and didn't use it for about two weeks, and my acne got so bad. I picked it up again at Ulta and oh my gosh it cleared so fast. Pros: clears acne super quickly, removes makeup pretty well, prevents acne and clears pores and blackheads Cons: it does dry out my skin but I don't find it to be a huge problem for me personally because I just apply moisturizer after using. It's also kind of expensive but it's Clinique and imo it's so worth it I DEFINITELY recommend this!!

avis.titre: Nothing else was helping my hormonal acne!
avis.texte: I tried everything for my hormonal acne, including prescription creams. Within days after using this twice daily, i started to see a change in my skin. For roughly a year or so prior, I was dealing with consistent breakouts. I hardly write reviews but highly texommend for those struggling with hormonal acne.
I really like this toner, it's not harsh on your skin but definitely brightens it
Since I had this product recommended to me I have been using it and provides very good results on my skin.

So i ordered this product online without reading the description. I was expecting an actual LOTION not liquid. However, since it was pricey and im desperate to relieve my acne, i decided to try it. Id definitely call this more of a "toner" bc you apply with a cotton ball and its a bottle of liquid. I will say that it makes my skin feel soooo soft and is not overdrying. I was looking for an acne treatment moisturizing lotion, but i am surprised and delighted with the benefits. I have used it twice already on my skin and neck and my skin feels soooo soft and smooth and its definitely shrinking the blemishes i have. Although i was initially disaapointed its not a "lotion" i am pleased with the effectiveness and will more than likely purchase again. Once it dries on your skin, id recommend throwing a moisturizer on top to prevent excess drying out.
Greatly improved my skin texture. A little pricey but for sure worth it.

Really controls acne breakout, I wear makeup 5 days out the week which in sure clog pores. I haven't had any breakouts since buying this product, I'm highly pleased. I use it once a week on my 12yr old because it is strong, but she have regular ance for someone facing puberty. I use this product 3x a week myself.

I've been using this for over 10 years and i'll never use anything else. Makes my skin feel clean and it really works well for me. I use this along with the treatment gel and face wash. Absolutely love it
I have been using this clarifying lotion twice a day along with the Acne Clearing Gel for spot treatments and it has worked miracles for my adult acne prone skin. Better than Paula's Choice toner!

avis.titre: I use this ALL the time and won't use anything else.
avis.texte: I love Clinique products and have used them for many years. I will not use anything else.
Use it on the outer edges of my face after cleaning and before using moisturizer at night and it is wonderful.
The Clinique Acne system along with this clarifying lotion is amazing! I was leary because it was so thin but it works great!
This helped my skin so much. Doesn't leave my face feeling dry & itchy. Because I have sensitive skin, I only use it once a day.

avis.titre: if you can get past the alcohol smell… it's good
avis.texte: This product definitely does the job. i'm not someone with acne prone skin but with my occasional breakouts, applying this "lotion" really helps. The only con is the horrendous smell of rubbing alcohol.
Bought this for my 15-year-old grandson. Only using at night seems to have helped greatly in such a short period of time.

avis.titre: I have use this for years and love it
avis.texte: I use it in the morning, it works while not drying out my skin
I absolutely love this product, it keeps my skin looking great!

I was very excited for this product but it turns out that it damages your skin and leaves you with very dark skin burns that take forever to lighten. It only aggravated my acne more than it helps to treat it please try another honest brand :(
This is a repeat purchase for my teenage daughter with regular breakouts. It is her favorite product and seems to do well managing her skin wellness.

I have struggled with acne on off over the past few years. The only thing that used to make it go away was antibiotics for acne. Those stopped working so i searched for products. This cleared my skin within a few weeks. I use it along with retinol every 2 nights and a spot treatment on the other nights if u have a breakout. I did experience burning at first for 2 days but after that it disappeared. I love this product. For reference I have dry skin.

This absolutely ruined my skin i have been using this for two days now and my skin if so dried out it burns like a sunburn. I got the system of these things and hopefully the others work because this one did not help at all just make issues worse

I recently have been experiencing Inflamed hormonal acne so I decided to give this a try. I use a cotton pad and use a very small amount to pat into my face and neck. The next day after trying this product my acne was way less inflamed. I've been using this product twice a day for a few weeks now, and while my acne isn't gone it's definitely helped a lot adding this to my skin care routine. Psa you will probably experience a little bit of irritation when you first start using this product.

avis.titre: Favorite for oily skin and breakouts
avis.texte: I've used Cliniqe for 20 years or more. Its 3 step skincare is the best. And can be customized for you skin.
I've been using this for years when I have a breakout. It even works great as a spot treatment!
The matte smell I just don't like.. it does the job though. I'll only use it at night & the #4 toner during the day after cleansing.
The bottle I have states it contains 1.5%salicylic acid. Not 2% like you are stating on ingredients

I've been using it for a long time now. I use it every night and after workouts. Keeps my skin from developing acne/helps treating it. It's pretty strong so make sure to not get too close to your eyes.

avis.titre: MAGIC GOT ACNE SKIN ! BUY IT !!!!!
avis.texte: LOVE IT ! I'm one with skin that marks easily due to acne and every time I use this product the marks become lighter and soon to be gone within a week or so . I been using for about 2 months now and I love it ! I'm telling you ! Purchase this toner because it really does work magic on the skin .

avis.titre: MAGIC GOT ACNE SKIN ! BUY IT !!!!!
avis.texte: LOVE IT ! I'm one with skin that marks easily due to acne and every time I use this product the marks become lighter and soon to be gone within a week or so . I been using for about 2 months now and I love it ! I'm telling you ! Purchase this toner because it really does work magic on the skin .

I've been using the Acne Solutions line for 4 months now and I have seen a HUGE difference in my skin. Like I've said in a previous review, I've been struggling with acne since elementary school, and now I'm in college. I've tried numerous of products, but Clinique is the first to actually work! This product has managed to clean my skin like it's supposed to. My only problem is that it fails to get the acne hiding deep beneath my skin, meaning that this exfoliator isn't strong enough to break through my skin so my face soap can get the flesh-colored pimples on my face. I was suggested to use this product STILL by a Clinique Beauty Consultant, but that I should also include their Turnaround Serum. Well, let's see how that goes...

avis.titre: I have used this since high school
avis.texte: I have extremely oily skin and am very prone to acne. I use this twice a day and can see a difference when i miss one to two treatments

I have acne prone skin due to having PCOS and this helps my acne flares. It isn't too harsh on my skin and it's amazing how you can see the dirt/makeup debris after you wash your face. It's amazing. I LOVE this stuff!
Great product recommend to me by a sales associate if you have oily skin I highly recommend this product!
I have used for many years. Non-drying. Perfect . Highly Recommend.

This product smells awful - BUT it is the only things that i can rely on for treating any mask, hormone, sugar breakouts.... especially for hormonal, cystic acne, i use this at bedtime and it continues to help clear my skin. if i use it too often, it does cause more white heads to appear, dries my skin out, & causes redness - so i just use it nightly or every other and it works great for me

avis.titre: Works for me, but I have heard bad things
avis.texte: Personally, this product has worked wonders for me. I have used it for many years and I have never had issues with it. I only use it at night so my skin won't be wonky in the morning.
Wearing mask all day acne this product is AMAZING and moisturizer
This contains alcohol which will dry out your skin and cause problems in the future. Do not get if you care about your skin

avis.titre: Try it.  With the face cleanser!
avis.texte: I'm 45 and didn't struggle with acne until I started early menopause. Add Covid and mask wearing and my skin was a nightmare. I did some research and decided to try this line. So glad I found it, because this is doing the trick for me! Have purchased more than 1x.

avis.titre: Not a Longterm Solution for Me
avis.texte: I had been using the normal 3-step Clinique products but wanted to try the acne products to see if they would dramatically help my acne/manage breakouts. I have acne along my cheeks and then will get breakouts around my chin. The first couple of weeks trying a new product can freak out your skin, but mine never rebounded. I used half of the bottle before giving up, I think this solution is just too much for me. I am back to my combination skin Clinique products and use this when I notice severe breakouts beginning to emerge. It definitely helps manage the breakouts when the appear, but not so much preventative and I definitely can't use it day in and day out. Once this bottle is done, I likely won't use it again.

avis.titre: It's impressive how dirty my face is after washing it
avis.texte: I have never had pimples before but now at my 41 years old my face has changed and I was getting one after other one non stop it didn't matter how I washed my face or what products I was using for oil/mix face, I started using it after washing my face and couldn't believe how much dirt I still had on my face, my face is clear in less than a week of using it once or twice a day, and using the Clinique acne gel after on each pimple. The alcohol smell is strong and I bet it could be really irritating for some skins but so far has helped me out to clear my face from all the breakouts

I gonna post this for a sencond time i don't know what happen with my other review about the product i think they deleted so don't buy this product broke my skin i use for a complete month and nothing happens my acne was worse my skin complete redness please read the ingredients contain alcohol after a never finish bottle i don't see nothing different just my skin getting worse so i stop using and when i don't put more this product at my skin everything was better and the redness dissappear

Ok i have a big stament about this product, i use this product for a whole month and make my skin worse than ever make me broke at areas that i never do , just i stop using at just at one day i feel better if you don't want your acne worse don't use
I have super sensitive skin, I went into ultra to find something different and new to try and the worker recommended this and it makes such a difference! Love it
I've been using this product on and off for years. Sometimes I try a new product, but I always come back to this one. Definitely helps heal and calm my cystic acne and scarring.

avis.titre: A perfect and necessary step in my skincare routine
avis.texte: I hope Clinique never discontinues this! It's so often hard to find in stock! It's the perfect toner for someone with acne prone skin, especially adults with hormonal and cystic acne. Salicylic acid is a key ingredient for fighting these kinds of breakouts and preventing them, but many products with this are overly harsh or contain too many other ingredients instead of a concentrated dose of salicylic acid. This formula isn't irritating but has enough salicylic acid to get the job done, plus the price is great when compared to similar products.

avis.titre: Really helps with stopping and ridding of pimples ias they s
avis.texte: I use daily after cleansing to prevent breakouts as well treating any pimples that start. This product stops pimples in their tracks. I have recommended it to family and friends that have trouble with breakouts.

avis.titre: More like a toner, than lotion
avis.texte: This is an odd product. It is liquid like toner, but has powder inside it. You have to shake iut up before each use. I bought it because I like the idea of "oil-absorbing" and it might do that, but it is not what I would call lotion at all. My skin is very sensitive and while I knew this product had acne medicine in it, it really irritated my face.
Worstened my breakouts and made my skin redder than ever. A lot of alcohol. Do not use if you have sensitive, acne-prone skin!

I have tried soooo many products. I used to have low maintenance, no acne skin. Randomly in my 20s I started having acne and this is the only thing that basically made it go away after trying all kinds of products for years. SO HAPPY with it! Always going to keep buying. I have oily skin and never used a moisturizer at night but I started using a light moisturizer after using this. I think that helped too.

I have suffered from acne for over 10+ years and this is the only product I have ever used that has consistently worked for more than 3 months without irritating my skin. I recommend this product to everyone especially now that we all wear masks for work. I can't wait to order more once it's back in stock.

I've been using this for almost two years now and I'm only on my second bottle. it lasts forever and it's so effective!! I started getting really bad acne at the end of high school and I started using this midway through my freshman year of college and it's amazing! I've only had occasional hormonal breakouts but this treats them and helps so much. my go to!
I love the product but I usually order from other places. When I finally got it in the mail it was not in its original packaging and it looked like it was open.

avis.titre: Received product damaged and half empty.
avis.texte: I was very excited about receiving this product, considering I planned on using it as part of my Clinique Acne Solutions routine that I am already doing, but upon opening my package, I found that it was damaged and half empty. I am now being forced to pay for shipping (without it being credited back to me) to return an item that I shouldn't have to be returning, but have no other option but to do so. Because of this damage and leak due to the poor packaging, the other items I ordered were also partially damaged.

avis.titre: Would buy again but not from Ulta
avis.texte: Love it!!! I have been battling breakouts for year and this really cleared me up!!

When I first used the acne solutions 3 step skin care routine my skin was doing better for about a week. After that after using the face wash and clarifying lotion my face would feel so dry and irritated and would make my face burn for hours. I definitely don't recommend this if you have sensitive skin like I do because your skin will be worse than it was before.
Love it! I have textured skin (combination) and it helps a lot i love this product
Bought for daughter. Got a sample pack during Christmas & she loved it.

avis.titre: I will continue to keep a bottle of this on hand always
avis.texte: My daughter uses this morning & night especially during that time of month to help keep her skin as clear as possible. I like having a bottle around to use for myself as well especially because my skin is super oily in the summer months.

I've bought so many bottles since I found this, I honestly love this toner. I'll wash my face then use this after and it gets the makeup left on the skin, sometimes it'll have this little burning feeling on some of my acne spots but honestly I love that feeling. I feel like it's actually doing something. I've tried different toner and honestly came right back to this, Ill always buy this toner. Def recommend!
I bought this product not knowing if it would work with my skin but it did and my skin is now clearer than ever

avis.titre: Awful smell and not a lotion
avis.texte: The smell of this is god awful. It smells like rubbing alcohol gone bad. It's also definitely not a "lotion." It's more of a drying out toner.

avis.titre: BEST 3-STEP FACE CLEANER I'VE EVER USED
avis.texte: I have used this day and night for 4 days in a row and my face is already so smooth and much more clearer than it was in the beginning of the week. For the past month i have trying to cover up my acne with foundation and just four days after use i came into work with a bare happy face!!

avis.titre: I would buy this product again and again.
avis.texte: I use the whole line of Clinique products for the acne on my face and I am totally satisfied with the way my skin looks: completely healthy! Thank you!
I love this and I've had flawless skin but it burns my face off and totally drys my skin out

I have no been able to find a toner for years that will eliminate my break outs. I have such sensitive skin and this toner still did not help. With in 2 weeks of using it my face was breaking out like it never had before. It did make the appearance of my skin healthier but I was constantly breaking out using this.

I not only use this on my face, but also my shoulders, back, and thighs. I have never found anything that worked for my body acne, and when I started using this on my body, I noticed immediate results. My face and body have never been so clear for so long. For reference, I am in my mid 30s with extremely oily skin. I went into Ulta without any makeup on and was told I had great skin. I have never had anyone tell me that before. I hope they never discontinue this product.

avis.titre: The best out of them all
avis.texte: I've been using this for a month or 2 and I can really see the dramatic change in my face. Even before eating healthy I've seen it cleared up a lot. After eating healthy I almost have no blemishes on my face. I get acne when I eat oily foods so I cut that out of my day to day life. This product, the acne cleansing foam, and the daily moisture all from Clinique go hand in hand with each other. Absolutely love these products!
My skin is so much healthier after just a few days. I wash and use this product twice a day. Pores look great, skin feels so good. Love love this product.
This stuff is seriously awesome! I've gone through 4 bottles and it's the one skincare item that I will continue to purchase again and again.

The Acne Soltions Clarifying Lotion works very well. I have oily skin yet, I really feel like this product works for any skin type. You can use the product once a day if it is too dry for you. I use this 'lotion' twice a day like introduced on the back of the bottle. And, I follow that with a Clinique Moisturizer. This 'lotion' really does reduce redness though out the >morning.< By the time it is brunch my redness is gone! The Acne Soltions Clarifying Lotion is a great product and it keeps my face clear from acne.
Not even using one time leaves my skin vulnerable for a blemish to Surface.

Our dermatologists stop carrying our insurance. my daughter uses this is after she washes her face morning and night. then she applies her acne treatment. When we run out of this you can definitely tell the difference in her skin. It's totally worth the purchase

avis.titre: Love this product! I now get conpliments on my skin.
avis.texte: I use this in the morning and at night. I can skip days. When I first used this product, it worked right away you can feel and see the difference.
I am on my 5th bottle and it really helps keeping my breakouts under control
This is a need for my skin care routine. I have such bad acne but when I use this I get no new breakouts and treat existing ones. A full size bottle lasts me about 2 months.

avis.titre: Already purchased a back up bottle.
avis.texte: I started using this because of the really back breakout situation I had after some medical issues. I was doing super aggressive treatment at home but didn't feel like the toner I had was really being a help. I have always had a good relationship with clinique products so I decided to try this and it did indeed start accelerating the healing. I'm over half done with my bottle and already bought a backup with my 20 off coupon. I hope they don't get rid of this, I may stockpile the whole system just in case. my face is doing so much better but it's not 100% but I don't know how it's needs will change in the coming weeks. But if I need to stick to acne products I may switch everything over to clinique.

I started using Clinique 2 years ago after it was introduced to me by a friend. I have not looked back since. I absolutely love it. Ii also have sensitive skin and so I have tried several things and they all have been very harsh for my face. This is absolutely perfect for my skin. Love it.

avis.titre: I would definitely buy this product again.
avis.texte: I bought this product for my 11year old daughter. Her skin is very sensitive due to eczema. She was starting to get really bad acne on her forehead. Also, she had dark ring around her eyes from her swimming googles. I started using this product on her about 3 weeks ago and I'm seeing great results. The dark circles are almost gone, her forehead is clearing out, and most importantly this product didn't let the eczema flare up.
I have sensitive skin acne prone 38 yr old female with autoimmune disease, this has helped clear my skin up tremendously!
I am almost 50, my wedding is in less than 2 months, I have battled acne all my life, but; since I started using Clinique, my skin has never been better! I'm hooked!

I have very sensitive skin, usually dries out really bad. This product works like a toner buuuut doesn't dry my skin out the way a toner does. It's been clearing my skin more and more each day and I also notice my complexion looks a bit more even. Definitely recommend.

I love this stuff! It was my first ever toner and most certainly my favorite. I use this on the days I use my The Origins Checks and Balances creme cleanser because this toner is exfoliating and I use my Thayers Rose Water toner(I added water) on the days that I use my Emeninence foaming cleanser because I never want to over do my skin.

So I got this as a free sample and it works miracles. Acne doesn't stand a chance against this! Takes away the redness of acne and dries it up real nice. That being said, you NEED to follow with a great moisturizer or you'll have real dry skin. I'm buying the full size bottle after I finish my sample!
Didnt do anything for my pores but it cleared my ance right up in like 2 weeks.

I'm one of those who has experienced acne worse as they've gotten older, instead of the teenage years. I bought this toner after reading rave reviews concerning adult acne. My skin is addicted! I notice a huge difference if I don't use this product. Even after I wash my face with the foaming cleanser, it still shows that there is left behind dirt, makeup, etc. after using this product. If I run out or skip this step in my routine, I notice a difference in the clarity of my skin. My pores look smaller and less clogged. It also helps to fade acne quicker in my opinion. My only suggestion would be to make sure you moisturize after using this product. If you don't, it will leave you with very dry skin. I go in with an intense moisturizer and facial oil when I'm done. Overall I am very impressed and will continue to purchase again and again! Definitely worth the price tag if you struggle with adult acne.
I've used this for years and always recommend to people definitely helped get rid of my acne. I use right after I wash my face and then use moisturizer once it drys Into skin

I absolutely love this line of products!!! It has worked to clear up my acne I will never use another acne product line!!! Please continue to make this product line and anyone looking for help with acne give this a try
At first, this acne solution set made my skin feel irritated but by week 2 my skin had balanced out and now loves it! I would definitely recommend this product
This is the best toner I've ever used! It's help my breakouts so much and my face is becoming so clear now! I love it!

The only thing I don't like is that my eyes for some reason, my bodies weird, seem red a little after using this. I'm personally confused about that, because there's no harsh odor to this. It's worth it though. If I'm in a situation where I can't clean my skip, say camping, I actually use this by itself and even though I end up using more (for obvious reasons) it still does great. I don't wear make up so you'd probably still want to remove your make up before hand even if you're in a jam. I've seen reviews online where people weren't happy with this, but make up always seems to be the related link, because it keeps my cystic acne under control and more than manageable. I'd suggest making sure all make up is completely removed before hand and follow up with a highly moisturizing product like moisture surge. I don't find this product drying, but if I don't moisturize after it makes me skin feel like it looks weird. I do notice I have some slight irritation after, but that clears up quickly after use (I have sensitive skin).

For the longest time I couldn't find anything to help with my acne prone skin. I'm in my 30's and it was so frustrating still dealing with this issue. I tried SO many things before using the Clinique acne like. I find that when I use the whole "3-step" system of theirs it works best, but each product on its own its pretty great. I have sensitive skin, but can handle using this twice a day - i just make sure to avoid anywhere near my eye area. It was a little drying when I first started using it, but it subsided as time went on. Will continue to use as long as they continue to make it!

I've been using Clinique products for a few years now and this really does clear up my face. It's a bit harsh for me to use everyday but if I see a breakout coming on this usually does the trick to stop it . If you have sensitive skin you may want to be careful with this. Over all I enjoy this toner and will keep a travel size on hand do bad days .

This is by far the best clarifying lotion I've used. It's essentially a toner and this one has talc at the bottom so when you mix it up and put it on any acne it will help dry it out. I've recommended it to my sister and friend and they both are repeat buyers of it. Great for oily skin

I've purchased this over 10 times and I absolutely love it. I have acne prone skin and it dries a pimple out after one use. I usually use it at nighttime after washing my face with teh Acne Solutions bar. The two together are magic. Very gently, not harsh and no smell.

I am not one to normally write reviews but I feel inclined to save anyone else out there thinking of adding this to their anti-acne routine. I have used the Clinique Clinical Clearing gel for years and love it! I still get hormonal breakouts on my chin though and thought this would help if I added it along with the clearing gel. I'm so glad I only used this on a patch of my skin at first. I dabbed a soaked cotton ball of this on the one big pimple I had for a few days..I felt like it worked to keep the head at bay. But then over the course of the next few days that area of my chin broke out SO bad. I'm not talking little white heads either...big painful, red bumps that take days to calm down. Maybe it was purging as I've read about that before...but the painful, extremely red line of pimples was too much for me to take. My skin has never looked so bad, I wanted to go into hiding. It seems this product does work for a lot of people, but definitely not for me. My advice if you really want to try is to only do a SMALL patch of skin for the first few weeks :(
I'm glad I invested in this product. My skin was noticeably more clear

avis.titre: Tried many products and this stuff works!!
avis.texte: I've tried products from dermalogica to proactive. I finally found something that worked for me and I could never be happier. Got rid of my acne in 2-3 days.
I cannot believe the results this product has gave me. My acne just disappeared within 3 days of using this.

At first when I first tried it it was a little strong an stinger a little bit then I was trying it more then the sting was not there my skin got used to it and it actually works just moisturize after u could use aloe Vera right after it's good
